classes.name: masks
classes.reason: In measure(), each iteration calls probe.read_staged(path_for(...,'class_a',...)) synchronously and only then proceeds to sleep_seconds(compute_s), so the calling rank stops and waits for each class_a read to finish before continuing, and no other rank is held up by it.

classes.name: tiles
classes.reason: class_b files are read inside the separate _prefetch process which pushes results onto a bounded queue ahead of consumption, so the read overlaps with the main loop's compute_s sleep and queue.get() consumption, meaning no rank is stalled waiting directly on the read itself, and only the prefetch worker accesses the file.
